title: RUCKBReasoning/ZR-0
abstract: # ZR-0: Training Vision-Language-Action Models with Dense Embodied Chain-of-Thought Supervision **ZR-0** is a pre-trained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation model designed for general-purpose robotic manipulation. ZR-0 System Overview: Joint Vision–Language Reasoning and Continuous Action Control --- ## Table of Contents - [What is ZR-0?](#what-is-zr-0) - [Key Features](#key-features) - [Target Audience](#target-audience) - [Quick Start](#quick-start) - [Environment Setup](#environment-setup) - [Model Checkpoints](#model-checkpoints) - [Model Inference](#model-inference) - [Evaluation](#evaluation) - [Fine-Tuning ZR-0 on Custom Datasets](#fine-tuning-zr-0-on-custom-datasets) - [Current & Future Work](#current--future-work) - [Contributors](#contributors) - [Acknowledgements](#acknowledgements) --- ## What is ZR-0? ZR-0 is a 2.6B parameter end-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model that leverages dense Embodied Chain-of-Thought (ECoT) supervision to learn cross-embodiment representations for robotic manipulation. **Architecture.** ZR-0 adopts a dual-stream architecture: a pre-trained VLM (Qwen3-VL-2B) serves as System 2 for structured reasoning, while a Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based action expert serves as System 1 for continuous action generation via flow matching. The two are coupled through cross-attention, with an attention mask that allows ECoT to be entirely skipped at inference, achieving ~90ms per action chunk on a single A6000 GPU. **Training Data.** ZR-0 is pre-trained on [ProcCorpus-60M](https://procvlm.github.io/), comprising 60M+ frames (~1,000 hours) from 400K+ trajectories across diverse embodiments (Franka, xArm, GR-1, ALOHA, ARX5, UR5, etc.), with 96.8% of frames annotated with dense ECoT reasoning traces. Example of Embodied Chain-of-Thought Reasoning **Training Objectives.** ZR-0 is jointly optimized with two objectives: next-token prediction for ECoT reasoning, and flow-matching for continuous action chunk generation. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出2.6B参数的端到端VLA模型ZR-0，采用双流架构：预训练VLM（Qwen3-VL-2B）作为System 2进行结构化ECoT推理，DiT动作专家作为System 1通过flow matching生成连续动作；两者经交叉注意力耦合，并设计注意力掩码使推理时可完全跳过ECoT以加速。模型在60M+帧的ProcCorpus-60M数据上联合优化ECoT下一token预测与flow matching动作生成两个目标。


# 一、动机

> 现有具身智能VLA模型缺乏结构化推理能力和跨本体泛化性，难以应对多样机器人平台的任务。ZR-0通过引入密集Embodied Chain-of-Thought（ECoT）监督，旨在学习通用的跨本体操控表示，同时提升可解释性和动作精度。


# 二、方法

> 提出2.6B参数的端到端VLA模型ZR-0，采用双流架构：预训练VLM（Qwen3-VL-2B）作为System 2进行结构化ECoT推理，DiT动作专家作为System 1通过flow matching生成连续动作；两者经交叉注意力耦合，并设计注意力掩码使推理时可完全跳过ECoT以加速。模型在60M+帧的ProcCorpus-60M数据上联合优化ECoT下一token预测与flow matching动作生成两个目标。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 预训练数据ProcCorpus-60M包含60M+帧（约1000小时）、400K+条轨迹，跨多种本体（Franka、xArm、GR-1、ALOHA、ARX5、UR5等），其中96.8%帧带有密集ECoT标注。推理时跳过ECoT后，在单张A6000 GPU上每个动作块延迟约90ms。


# 四、对我的启发

> 与课题直接相关。启发：密集ECoT监督将推理过程显式注入VLA训练，有助于学习跨本体可迁移表示，且推理阶段可灵活裁剪实现实时控制；但文中未报告下游任务定量对比，实际泛化优势有待原文进一步评估。
